# Zanzibaba Survey & Geospatial — Land Surveying in Zanzibar

## About
Zanzibaba Survey & Geospatial provides professional land and construction surveying services in Zanzibar. We offer topographical surveys, boundary verification, plot subdivision, construction setting out, engineering surveys, drone surveys, GIS mapping, and hydrographic surveys.

## Services
- Topographical Surveys
- Boundary Surveys
- Plot Subdivision
- Construction Setting Out
- Engineering Surveys
- Drone Surveys
- Cadastral Surveys
- GIS Mapping
- Hydrographic Surveys

## Location
- Headquarters: Stone Town, Zanzibar, Tanzania
- Service coverage: All areas of Zanzibar
